Overview
This 6-week program is designed for advanced to elite
boulders (V8/7B and above). This program was built in
collaboration with Emil Abrahamsson as part of his 3-
part training series on going from VO to V15 and looks
to address the skills that he sees as most important
for bouldering specialists. This program is best suited
for climbers that wish to train 3 days per week. During
the first week of the program, athletes will assess their
current finger strength and max pull-ups.
Climbers that prefer to perform Edge Lifts should use
the Edge Lift protocol instead of the One-arm Max
Hang.
A suggested weekly schedule for the program is:
Session 1: One-arm Max Hangs & Hard Projecting
Session 2: Campus Latch & Campus Bouldering
Session 3: Volume Session & Weighted Pull-ups
